annotator_separation: The reference-only annotator opened only the five frozen reference viewports. Query pixels, source and protocol JSON, full panoramas, model output, and other candidate pixels were not opened.
admission_rule: ADMITTED requires exactly one tight, visibly identifiable pedestrian entrance portal containing x=512. A hidden ray is NOT_VISIBLE; multiple plausible portals or non-unique boundaries are AMBIGUOUS. Building identity or scene context cannot substitute for pixel visibility.

episodes.rationale: x=512 falls on a wall or facade divider; the clear large glazed entrance is left of the ray and does not contain it.
The ray falls on a broad horizontal shutter or closed facade, not a tight visible pedestrian entrance portal.
x=512 crosses a parking-garage vehicle opening; the broad opening is not an identifiable pedestrian entrance portal.
The ray crosses an overexposed facade and continuous dark panels or garage area, with no independently identifiable tight pedestrian doorway.
A tree trunk occludes the ray area and several door-like or glazed divisions remain plausible, so one portal boundary cannot be fixed uniquely.
